name: Newsletter sign-up
description: An email field and a button, with a thank-you message.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/newsletter-signup", name: "Newsletter sign-up", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "An email field and a button, with a thank-you message.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Box(padding: Space.lg, radius: Radius.lg, background: Color.surfaceAlt, child: Form(id: "newsletter", onSubmit: ShowMessage(message: "Thanks! Check your inbox."), child: Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
      Text(child: "Get first dibs on new bakes", size: FontSize.lg, weight: FontWeight.bold),
      TextField(name: "email", label: "Email", type: InputType.email, placeholder: "you@example.com", required: true),
      SubmitButton(label: "Subscribe", fullWidth: true)
    ])))
  )],
)
